note: PostFinance's prices for private customers: the Smart bank package, for adults from 20, costs 5 francs a month per customer relationship (free with investments of 25,000 francs, a life insurance or a mortgage, not modelled); under 20 the SmartYoung package is free, so the game waives it there. A customer living outside Switzerland and Liechtenstein pays 25 francs a month more per account, not modelled.
